exposes.nature: Jetson Orin (Seeed reComputer J401) hexapod robot — 18-DoF, 3× Arduino Mega 2560 + BTS7960 H-bridges, ZED 2i RGB-D. Runs the on-robot locomotion stack (HAL server + gamepad/policy inference) via `krabby run`. Physical lab hardware, not a shared compute resource.

Public S3 firmware store — versioned Arduino Mega builds per branch (index.json + per-branch latest.json/builds.json + firmware.hex), flashed via `krabby firmware update`. Read-only public artifacts; no credentials.

Public ECR locomotion image — the on-robot Docker stack (HAL server + policy inference + firmware tooling). Channels: release-latest (stable, pulled by `krabby install`) and mainline-latest (dev). Public registry; no credentials.
